{"thought": "配送天數的期間要依訂單成立時間（台北時間）歸屬，需先確認 orders.order_ts 的儲存格式與時區，才能正確篩選 2025 年第二季。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"query": "SELECT o.order_id, o.order_ts, s.shipped_ts, s.delivered_ts FROM orders o JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id = o.order_id WHERE s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL LIMIT 5"}}

{"thought": "配送天數要依訂單成立時間（台北時間，即 UTC+8）歸屬到 2025 年第二季，並只計已送達的出貨，且所有物流商合併計算。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"query": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(julianday(s.delivered_ts) - julianday(s.shipped_ts)), 2) AS avg_days, SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(s.delivered_ts) < julianday(s.shipped_ts) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id WHERE s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL AND datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours') >= '2025-04-01 00:00:00' AND datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours') < '2025-07-01 00:00:00'"}}
